config.hypothesis: Original quaternion grouping may retain better whole-network quality than predetermined role-preserving/free fully mixed assignments after matched physical compression and three-epoch repair on EuroSAT CNN6.
config.scope: Three existing four-band EuroSAT quaternion CNN6 parents, three conditions,9actual compact models and27repair epochs. Halve only the hidden quaternion widths between the two convolutions of blocks0/2, leaving block outputs, pooling/dropout, other block and real readout unchanged. All models have44794real trainables versus73898parents, about39.4percent whole-model savings; this is not the14.5percent CIFAR budget. No new parent, alternative algebra/dimension, group search, BN sweep or official-test evaluation.
config.data: Use the existing disjoint19600TRAIN/1000validation/1000calibration/5400test split and NIR,R,G,B preprocessing. FIT is the500even-calibration examples; CHECK is the500odd-calibration examples. Test is never inferred. Reuse native-trained local activation targets, retained scalar sets and original/role_100_0/free_100_0 assignments from the completed statistics control. Draw0is fixed before outcomes and never selected from the ten draws. Masks came from existing native-trained FIT activation energy; all three conditions retain exactly the SAME scalar multiset per seed/site. These calibration/validation splits were explored previously; this is not blind confirmation.
config.realization: Wrap each existing sequential conv-BN-ReLU-conv-BN-ReLU pair only for compilation. Reuse the frozen Hamilton producer projection, scalar BN copying and consumer initialization. Install only the smaller ordinary Hamilton/BN modules back into the same sequential CNN; no router, gather, dense adapter or full producer in deployed inference. Recompute producer input packs from source-prefix eval inference and verify a native consumer batch bitwise against frozen local packs. Use every FIT spatial position and fixed zero-centered Hamilton consumer ridge; lambda inherited from the original native local diagnostic and identical across conditions. CHECK only measures fitted error. Exact-feature diagnostic MSE is reused from predecessor rows and is not a physical-model lower bound. Save producer errors/projection loss, physical fit/check errors and actual local checkpoint replay.
config.full_models: Combine both compact pairs into each whole model, measure validation/CHECK accuracy and CE before repair, then repair all surviving parameters with frozen AdamW/AMP augmentation recipe for final epoch3. Same order/augmentation seeds within each source seed; record dropout/RNG and successful/attempted updates through the existing repair function.19600train images give154batches per epoch and462attempted updates per model, unlike1125in CIFAR; equal epochs/recipe across datasets are not equal update/compute budgets. Save native/final models and per-example logits/labels, then verify reload predictions and metrics. No best-epoch or condition selection.
config.primary: Report original-minus-role and original-minus-free final epoch3validation accuracy gaps in percentage points separately for each source seed and descriptive means over3parents. Positive gap favors original grouping. Also report paired validation CE, raw before/after values and CHECK outcomes; unfavorable/reversed differences remain in the report. Compare to the same100percent mixed CIFAR cases as a cross-dataset/architecture description, not a pooled significance test. No continuation threshold or automatic further experiment.
config.checks: Before freeze: pair extraction/installation, exact original and dense inverse-permutation controls, saved compact state replay, fixed scalar-set enforcement and parameter counts, source-input hook cleanup, full synthetic local-fit/model-repair/completed-resume, plus discarded compact GPU tracked-variable/all-quaternion-component gradient/update audit. During science: frozen source/input hashes, parent validation replay, activation replay, per-case gradient audit on discarded copies, fitted-block prediction replay, final saved-model/logit replay and artifact hashes. STOP between data/model/local batches and existing repair updates; completed artifacts verified/reused, partial local fits repeat at most one case.
config.interpretation: This is practical replication on a second dataset AND architecture/input encoding. It does not isolate a dataset effect, prove semantic necessity, global optimality, equivalence, method novelty or conference readiness. Earlier failed adaptation/reassembly/exchange gates remain failed. Do not tune this bounded study or add repairs after observing outcomes.
